response.answer: Juliet Nsimire Sendagala is a leading researcher in rapid point-of-care methods for identifying Group B Streptococcus. Her work focuses on improving intrapartum treatment in Uganda. She collaborates with prestigious institutions like the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine.
